# Marian Stancik

> Personal brand website, technical knowledge graph, and autonomous multi-agent engineering hub of Marian Stancik — AI Engineer, UAV Builder, and Law Scholar.

Marian Stancik builds autonomous agent ecosystems (Hermes Agent, MCP), hand-soldered tactical UAV edge AI drones (ArduPilot, Raspberry Pi 5), and legal-by-design compliance architectures (EU AI Act, GDPR, NIS2, DORA).

## Core Pages

- [Home](https://www.marianstancik.dev/): High-impact hero, autonomous agent stats, live 24/7 cron orchestrations, and connect channels.
- [About](https://www.marianstancik.dev/about): Technical bio, 4-layer engineering stack (Hetzner VPS, OpenRouter, Obsidian, Zero-build Web), and career timeline.
- [Expertise](https://www.marianstancik.dev/expertise): Detailed spec matrices across 3 core pillars: Autonomous AI Agents, Law & AI Compliance, and UAV Edge AI Systems.
- [AI Engineering Skills](https://www.marianstancik.dev/skills): Full-stack skills taxonomy covering Build & Deploy AI, Software Engineering, LLM & Agentive Systems, and Production Operations.
- [Tactical UAV Systems](https://www.marianstancik.dev/drones): Hand-soldered 1500g carbon quadcopter, ArduPilot Copter autopilot, Raspberry Pi 5 edge vision AI, and flight logs.
- [Blog](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog): Technical articles on autonomous AI workflows, legal-by-design compliance (AI Act, GDPR), and robotics.
- [Contact](https://www.marianstancik.dev/contact): Direct lead capture, communication channels, and social profiles.

## Technical Articles

- [Web Performance Optimization: Cutting Page Size by 61%](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-08-25-web-performance-optimization): Reducing page weight, optimizing Core Web Vitals, non-blocking WebGL, and achieving Lighthouse 100.
- [Building a Digital Twin That Posts 9x Daily](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-08-22-building-digital-twin): Autonomous social content distribution across 6 platforms using Python, cron, and LLMs.
- [AI Act Compliance for Small AI Companies](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-08-20-ai-act-compliance): Practical legal-by-design guide for startups navigating EU AI Act risk tiers and GPAI obligations.
- [Autonomous Drone Missions with ArduPilot & Python](https://www.marianstancik.dev/blog/posts/2026-08-17-autonomous-drone-missions): Hands-on UAV mission automation with Pixhawk, ArduPilot, and Python waypoint scripting.
